title: Package vocabulary
description: What a package adds to the commons' vocabulary for its own use (data/packages/<id>/vocabulary.yaml, optional): modalities, movement patterns and equipment. Only the package, and a philosophy that borrows from it, may name them. A new id never replaces one the commons define. What stays the engine's: slot types, progression and contract models, phase kinds, levels, intensities, watch templates and icons.

modalities.description: Modalities this package adds. Each is a modality (modality.schema.json: recovery cost, session position, display…) with the analytics family it rolls up into.

id.description: A new id; not one the commons define (data/commons/modalities).

family.description: The analytics family it rolls up into: a key of data/commons/modality_families.json `families` (strength, aerobic, intervals, durability, skill, combat). Heart rate, load and the modality mix read it.

progression_model.description: How its slots progress when the framework says nothing: one of the engine's progression models (framework.schema.json `progression_model`).

movement_patterns.description: Movement patterns this package's exercises name beyond the commons' (data/commons/recovery_regions.yaml `patterns` and `unloaded`).

id.description: A new id; not one the commons define.

regions.description: Where the pattern's work lands on the body, 0-1 per region (lower, upper_push, upper_pull, trunk, cardio: data/commons/recovery_regions.yaml `regions`). {} for a pattern that loads nothing (a mobilisation, breathing).

excluded_by.description: The injury flags (data/commons/constraints/injury_flags.yaml ids) that rule this pattern out. Required, so it is stated: [] says no injury excludes it. An athlete with one of these flags gets no exercise of this pattern.

equipment.description: Implements this package's exercises and archetypes need beyond the commons' list (data/commons/constraints/equipment.yaml). The athlete ticks them like any other; an archetype or exercise that needs one is filtered out for an athlete without it.

id.description: A new id; not one (or an alias of one) the commons list.
